verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure, pink panel, zigzag, headline and arrow rows. Its flaws: the pink panel starts about 60 px below the top and stops short of the bottom, leaving bare grey photo strips above and below; the left zigzags end in mid-air; and the panel reads as a scaled copy rather than a rearrangement. B wrecks the brand system: the pink zigzag panel is reduced to an opaque block over the pendant lamps and chairs; white 'YOUR SPACE' sits on the busy ceiling photo; 'EXPAND' is moved below the headline (wrong reading order) and is low-contrast white on light grey; the arrow rows collide with a stray zigzag glyph at the bottom.
